Projects

Three systems I built. Each diagram follows the data through it; choose a step to trace it.

  • AI travel planner
  • Real-time graph analytics
  • Elastic recognition service

AI travel planner

Applied AI, built with Python and LangGraph.

Plans activities for a trip and adjusts the itinerary to fit the traveler’s budget.

Real-time graph analytics

Streaming data, built with Kafka and Neo4j.

Streams New York City taxi trips into a graph. PageRank ranks connected locations, and breadth-first search traces paths between them.

Elastic recognition service

Cloud systems, built with AWS EC2 and SQS.

Buffers recognition requests in an SQS queue so EC2 inference workers can process them independently of the web tier.
